preconditions.description: The number of tiles n is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i in {1, 2} for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each tile value a_i is either 1 or 2.

postconditions.description: The output permutation b has the same length as the input sequence a.
The output permutation b contains the same elements as the input sequence a.

postconditions.expression: max_primes(b) >= max_primes(c) for all c in permutations(a)
postconditions.description: The number of prime prefix sums in the output permutation b is maximized among all permutations of a.
